privacy.metaDescription: VALENTRO Atelier Privacy Policy. Learn about how we manage and protect your data.
privacy.subtitle: Policy of Discretion
privacy.title: The Maison's Commitment
privacy.introduction: In the realm of haute parfumerie, discretion is as vital as the rarest absolute. At Valentro, we regard your personal information with the same reverence and meticulous care as our most precious essences. This document outlines our steadfast dedication to preserving the sanctity of your digital footprint, ensuring that your journey with our Maison remains entirely yours.

essence.title: The Essence of Information
essence.intro: To curate an experience worthy of the Valentro name, we gather specific notes of information, blended seamlessly to anticipate your desires without intrusion.

card1.title: Identity & Contact
card1.desc: The fundamental signatures—your name, atelier address, and means of correspondence—allowing us to recognize you across all touchpoints.

card2.title: Scent Profile
card2.desc: Your olfactory preferences, past acquisitions, and bespoke consultations, meticulously archived to refine future recommendations.

card3.title: Technical Impressions
card3.desc: Subtle digital echoes—IP addresses, browser comportment, and device signatures—utilized strictly to optimize the architecture of our digital boutique and ensure an immaculate browsing experience.

item1.title: Bespoke Curation
item1.desc: Your data serves as the foundation for a deeply personalized relationship. It allows us to present you with early access to limited reserves, invite you to exclusive atelier events, and tailor our digital displays to reflect your distinct aesthetic.

item2.title: Fulfillment & Execution
item2.desc: We utilize your information to flawlessly execute the delivery of your acquisitions, from the meticulous packaging in our Parisian atelier to the white-glove arrival at your residence.

item3.title: The Inner Circle
item3.desc: With your explicit consent, we invite you into our Inner Circle, a sanctum of private correspondence where we share the inspiration behind new creations and stories from the perfumer's bench.

sovereignty.title: Your Sovereignty
sovereignty.intro: You hold absolute dominion over your personal narrative. We honor your right to direct how your information is engaged within our Maison.

right1.title: The Right of Access
right1.desc: Request a comprehensive ledger of the data we hold, presented with clarity and transparency.

right2.title: The Right of Erasure
right2.desc: Command the immediate removal of your presence from our archives, returning to anonymity.

right3.title: The Right of Rectification
right3.desc: Amend or refine your details at any moment, ensuring our records remain an accurate reflection of your current state.

bastion.title: Our Bastion of Privacy
bastion.desc1: The architecture of our digital presence is fortified with enterprise-grade encryption and rigorous access protocols. We employ state-of-the-art cryptographic measures to shield your data from unauthorized observation, ensuring that the enclave of your personal information remains impenetrable.
bastion.desc2: Our commitment to security is an ongoing pursuit, continually reviewed and refined by independent auditors to meet the most exacting global standards of digital luxury and discretion.

refund.metaDescription: VALENTRO Atelier Refund Policy. Understand our policies on returns and refunds.
refund.subtitle: Valentro Policies
refund.title: The Art of Return
refund.introduction: A Graceful Return. We handle your changing desires with the same reverence as our scent creation. Our commitment to your olfactory journey remains absolute, even when a path diverges.

window.title: The 30-Day Window
window.desc1: Time is essential in truly experiencing a fragrance, but decisions require clarity. We offer a generous 30-day window from the date of receipt to request a return for any eligible Valentro creation.
window.desc2: This period allows you to consider your acquisition in the comfort of your home, ensuring the piece resonates with your personal aesthetic and intentions.
window.bullet2: Funds returned to original payment method.
window.bullet3: Processing takes 5-7 business days upon receipt.

sanctuary.title: The Sanctuary of Scent
sanctuary.desc: For the integrity of our creations and the safety of our clientele, all returned fragrances must remain unopened, entirely sealed within their original cellophane, and in pristine condition.
sanctuary.protocolDesc: To ensure absolute confidence in your selection, every full-sized fragrance order includes a complimentary 2ml sample vial of the identical scent. We invite you to experience the sample first. If the olfactory narrative does not align with your spirit, the unopened full bottle may be returned.

path.title: The Path to Resolution
path.intro: Initiating a return is a curated, effortless process designed to respect your time.
path.step1Desc: Navigate to your Atelier account or contact our Concierge to request a Return Authorization code.
path.step2Desc: Carefully package the unopened item in its original shipping materials, including all documentation.
path.step3Desc: Affix the provided prepaid shipping label and tender the parcel to our designated premium courier.

exclusions.title: Exclusions of Rarity
exclusions.intro: Certain creations are bound to their initial patron and cannot traverse backward.
exclusions.card1Desc: Fragrances crafted through our personalized Bespoke service, tailored precisely to your unique specifications and engraved with your moniker, are final sale. Their intimate nature precludes any possibility of return.
exclusions.card2Desc: Due to the exploratory and consumable nature of our curated Discovery Sets and individual sample vials, these items are ineligible for return or exchange once dispatched from our Maison.

terms.metaDescription: The terms and conditions for shopping with VALENTRO Atelier.
terms.subtitle: Valentro Policies
terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.introduction: These terms explain how you may use Valentro and shop with us. Please read them before placing an order.

acceptance.title: 1. Acceptance of these terms
acceptance.body: By using our website or placing an order, you agree to these Terms & Conditions and our Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, please do not use the website or place an order.

orders.title: 2. Orders and account information
orders.body: Please provide complete and accurate contact, delivery, and order information. Orders are subject to availability and confirmation by Valentro. We may decline or cancel an order when information is inaccurate, a product is unavailable, or we reasonably suspect misuse.

products.title: 3. Products and availability
products.body: We aim to present every fragrance and its details accurately. Product images, packaging, and scent perception can vary slightly. Availability is shown in good faith and may change before an order is confirmed.

pricing.title: 4. Prices and payment
pricing.body: Prices are shown in Egyptian pounds (EGP) unless stated otherwise. Any applicable delivery charge is presented during checkout or confirmed with you before dispatch. Orders are currently paid by cash on delivery.

delivery.title: 5. Delivery
delivery.body: We deliver to supported governorates in Egypt. Delivery dates are estimates and can be affected by courier operations, weather, or circumstances outside our control. Please make sure someone is available to receive the order at the confirmed address.

returns.title: 6. Returns and refunds
returns.body: Returns and refunds are handled under our Refund Policy. In case of a conflict, the Refund Policy governs the conditions and process for return requests.

care.title: 7. Fragrance care and safe use
care.body: Use fragrances externally and as directed. Avoid contact with eyes, avoid spraying near a flame, and discontinue use if irritation occurs. Store bottles upright and away from heat and direct sunlight.

intellectualProperty.title: 8. Our content and intellectual property
intellectualProperty.body: The Valentro name, logo, photography, product descriptions, and website content belong to Valentro or its licensors. You may not copy, reproduce, or use them commercially without our written permission.

changes.title: 9. Changes and applicable law
changes.body: We may update these terms when needed. The version published on this page applies to your use of the website. These terms are governed by the applicable laws of the Arab Republic of Egypt.

contact.title: 10. Contact us
contact.body: For questions about these terms or an order, please contact our team at concierge@valentro.com.
